answer_1.quote: As machine translation (MT) becomes more deeply embedded in daily life through apps and chatbots, people increasingly rely on it for casual, everyday tasks: understanding signs, browsing foreignlanguage content, and making quick decisions.

answer_2.quote: Automatic metrics emerged to provide rapid quality assessments, comparing system outputs to professional reference translations using n-gram overlap  or neural methods .

answer_4.quote: We crowdsource three independent validation checks to ensure that text and images are interpreted as intended. These checks helped filter out ambiguous messages and unintuitive text-image pairings. Native English speakers assessed translation fluency and selected matching images based on English translations, while proficient Spanish speakers did so based on the Spanish source.
answer_4.guideline: Native English speakers assessed translation fluency and selected matching images based on English translations, while proficient Spanish speakers did so based on the Spanish source.
